## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint`, `make test` and `make goldens` pass.
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (unit, golden or web test).
- [ ] Changed goldens are named here, each with why it changed (or: none changed).
- [ ] A serialised Rust type changed: I ran `make types` and committed the result (or: not needed).
- [ ] User-visible change: an entry in `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased` (or: not user-visible).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO).
